updates.scope: metadata-level lineage, source rehydration and regeneration-claim validation only
remaining_blockers: no executed transform-regeneration engine; witnesses are externally supplied attestations

updates.new_requirement: derived views preserve immutable source identity through hash-pinned transitive canonical closure and never replace canonical history
derived memory representations may preserve source authority certificates but may not mint certificates absent from direct sources; new synthesis authority requires its own governed canonical claim

updates.problem: The bounded context compiler selects a deterministic set but does not experimentally govern record ordering or separation. Current long-context evidence shows performance can depend on position, distance between relevant pieces and total context length even when retrieval succeeds.
updates.target: Freeze matched evidence packets that vary only record order/separation for contradiction pairs, mechanism ancestry chains and multi-hop evidence, then measure downstream fidelity under fixed selected-record sets before adopting any order policy.
updates.safety_boundary: Do not optimize ordering post hoc on the same downstream cases used for authority; ordering remains an execution heuristic, not evidence.
